_comment: tokens: name -> regex counted per file (comments and string contents stripped first).
Lookbehinds exclude identifier characters so Params( does not match SelectParams( or
MutableParams(, and time(nullptr does not double-count std::time(nullptr.
extra_files: headers that belong to a tier but appear in no CMake source list.
exempt_files: the chain-parameters implementation itself — the gate polices consumers
of ambient state, not the one definition site.
